title: MiniMax Quota State
description: Persisted 5-hour sliding-window quota state for the MiniMax free tier. Written to ~/.maestro/minimax-quota.json and protected by an fs2 advisory file lock. Unknown fields are rejected by #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] in the Rust struct. Schema is at v2 (#845); v1 files are accepted via a read shim in `MinimaxQuota::open_with` that promotes them in place to v2 with `forced_count = 0` and rewrites on the next save.

schema_version.description: Schema version sentinel. Writers always emit 2. Readers accept 1 (migrated in place by the v1→v2 shim) or 2 (strict). Any other value causes MinimaxQuota::open_with to return an UnsupportedSchemaVersion error.

requests.description: RFC 3339 timestamps (UTC) of every request recorded in the current 5-hour rolling window. Entries older than 5 hours are pruned on every read.

items.description: UTC timestamp in RFC 3339 format, e.g. 2026-05-21T12:00:00Z

forced_count.description: Number of `--force-quota` bypasses recorded in the current 5h window (#845). Resets to 0 when window pruning leaves `requests` empty. Surfaced as a 'QUOTA: forced N in window' footer badge on the home screen when non-zero. Added in v2; v1 files default to 0 via the read shim.
